# OGIFT — Onati Global Institute of Fashion Technology

> Bangalore's best fashion design institute. Rated 4.9★. Founded in 2010.
> AI-powered, multilingual (English, Hindi, Kannada). Admissions 2026 open.

## About
OGIFT (Onati Global Institute of Fashion Technology) is a fashion design institute located in Vinayakanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded in 2010, OGIFT is rated 4.9★ based on 250+ Google reviews and is widely regarded as one of Bangalore's best fashion design institutes. The institute provides 100% placement support and delivers courses in English, Hindi, and Kannada. It uses AI-powered tools including an AI Portfolio Builder, Virtual Fashion Counsellor, and conversational AI agents for personalised learning.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2010
- Rating: 4.9★ (250+ Google reviews)
- Placement: 100% placement support
- Placement partners: Fabindia, Myntra, Raymond, Zara, H&M and 50+ fashion brands
- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada
- Eligibility: Class 10 (SSC) and above, no prior design experience required
- Admissions: Open for 2026
